description: This file contains utility functions for AJAX operations, including dynamic dependent dropdown population, service result fetching, UOM conversion check, and timezone initialization, used within a web application.

methods.name: getDependentDropdownValues
methods.description: Dynamically populates a dependent dropdown based on a parent dropdown's value via AJAX call.

methods.name: getServiceResult
methods.description: Performs a synchronous AJAX POST request to a given service URL and returns the result.

methods.name: prepareAjaxData
methods.description: Prepares data array for AJAX request from variable arguments.

methods.name: checkUomConversion
methods.description: Checks if a Unit of Measure conversion exists by calling a service.

methods.name: initTimeZone
methods.description: Initializes timezoneJS with configuration for timezone data loading.
